cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our cakes tied. I'll settle it with blindfolded icing: next round, loser cleans the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result. Can we leave it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while I'm keeping score. You'll each get one minute and the same amount of icing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to bake another cake. We already have two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then decorate one spare biscuit each. Same blindfolds, same minute; I'll have the judge compare them. You may skip the extra baking, but the lower score still gets the washing-up.

reason: Make B existing-cake objection cause a smaller concrete icing test while explicitly preserving equal time, judge comparison and loser cleaning, with A granting only the no-baking concession.
